statement: A ninja trains for n days. Each day he does exactly one of three activities, numbered 0, 1 and 2.
The n × 3 matrix points gives the merit points: points[i][j] is what activity j earns on day i. He may not do the same activity on two days in a row.
Return the largest total number of merit points he can earn over the n days.

examples.explanation: Do activity 2 on day 0 (70), activity 1 on day 1 (50) and activity 0 on day 2 (30): 70 + 50 + 30 = 150. The 80 on day 1 needs activity 2 again, so it cannot follow the 70.
Do activities 2, 0, 1, 0 on days 0 to 3: 5 + 3 + 3 + 5 = 16. No activity repeats on consecutive days.
